name: Li Wei
bio:
Li Wei's motorsport journey began in his youth, captivated by the technical intricacies of Formula One. Despite not having the resources to pursue racing himself, he channeled his passion into engineering, earning a degree in mechanical engineering from Tsinghua University. He initially worked in the automotive industry, but his heart remained in motorsport. He transitioned to karting, finding an opportunity to apply his technical knowledge and strategic thinking.

Li Wei's approach as a sporting director is deeply rooted in data analysis and meticulous planning. He believes in empowering his team through clear communication and well-defined roles. While he values innovation, his focus remains on maximizing performance through proven strategies and efficient execution. He is known for his calm demeanor under pressure, a trait that allows him to make rational decisions even in the heat of competition. His pragmatic leadership has earned him respect within the Kart Academy.

What sets Li Wei apart is his blend of technical expertise and management acumen. He understands the engineering challenges of the sport, but he's equally adept at motivating and coordinating his team. This combination allows him to bridge the gap between the technical and operational aspects of racing, ensuring that the team operates at peak efficiency.

physical.hairStyle: Short, neatly combed back with slight receding hairline.
physical.description: Li Wei is a lean man of medium height, with a thoughtful expression etched on his face.

quirks: Insists on using a traditional abacus for quick calculations during strategy sessions.
Always carries a small notebook filled with handwritten technical diagrams.
Has a habit of tapping his pen rhythmically when deep in thought.
